items.title: Firefighters in Spain and France battle raging wildfires – video
items.description: <p>Footage shows the extent of the devastation caused by wildfires in Cenicientos, in the Madrid region of Spain, on Friday. Members of Spain's military emergency unit sought to contain the blazes in the Madrid region and in Cuevas de Cañart in the country's north-east. In France, dozens of firefighters battled flames threatening homes around the towns of Saumos and Sainte-Hélène in the south-west as a wildfire swept the nearby forest. sections.title: Beyond Climate — Other Major EU News

items.title: Trump threatens EU with tariff probe over Google, tech fines
items.description: US President Donald Trump has said he will initiate a tariff investigation against the EU in response to fines against US tech companies. He cited the latest case that Google lost on Thursday, as well as others.

items.description: The US president says fines against Google, as well as Apple, Meta and Amazon, should be "entirely reversed."

items.title: Europe wildfires rage on, forcing more than 250,000 from homes
items.description: From the outskirts of Bordeaux to communities near Madrid, fast-moving wildfires in France and Spain are driving mass evacuations, destroying homes, and claiming lives.
